title: Jamaican Jerk Pork with Gratin and Roasted Vegetables
description: A flavorful jerk pork dish paired with a creamy gratin and roasted vegetables, perfect for a warm night.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with Jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork shoulder until browned on both sides.
Transfer the pork to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the pork is cooking, toss the plum tomatoes and diced tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
To make the gratin, combine pre-made or homemade gratin with chopped epic and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Serve the jerk pork with roasted vegetables and a side of creamy gratin.
Garnish with additional chopped epic and serve immediately.
